requirements.requirement: The system must write normalized prescription records to the MongoDB collection PublicHealthData.prescriptions.
The system must batch prescription records into configurable batch sizes before performing MongoDB write operations.
The system must use bulk write operations (e.g., insertMany or bulkWrite) for each batch.
The system must enforce idempotency such that reprocessing the same input does not create duplicate records.
The system must upsert records based on a deterministic unique key derived from normalized prescription fields.
The system must validate each record against the schema defined in PIPE-RX-INGEST-S1 before attempting persistence.
The system must log successful batch writes including batch size and execution time.
The system must log failed write operations with sufficient detail to identify affected records.
The system must skip and record invalid records without halting the entire batch process.
The system must retry failed MongoDB write operations for transient errors up to a defined retry limit.
The system must terminate processing and raise an error if MongoDB connection cannot be established.
The system must ensure all writes are directed to the correct database and collection as defined in configuration.
The system must process input records sequentially through the pipeline_worker_base pattern lifecycle methods.
The system must produce a final summary report including total processed, successfully written, skipped, and failed records.
